items.name: CommandError
items.summary: An error that can occur while running a command and reading its output.

items.name: CommandReader
items.summary: A streaming reader for a command's output.

methods.name: close
methods.summary: Closes the CommandReader, freeing any resources used by its underlying child process. If the child process exits with a nonzero exit code, the returned Err value will include its stderr.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new streaming reader for the given command using the default configuration.

items.name: CommandReaderBuilder
items.summary: Configures and builds a streaming reader for process output.

methods.name: async_stderr
methods.signature: fn async_stderr(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut CommandReaderBuilder
methods.summary: When enabled, the reader will asynchronously read the contents of the command's stderr output. When disabled, stderr is only read after the stdout stream has been exhausted (or if the process quits with an error code).

methods.name: build
methods.signature: fn build(&self, command: &mut process::Command) -> Result<CommandReader, CommandError>
methods.summary: Build a new streaming reader for the given command's output.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new builder with the default configuration.
